title: Lockscreen/Always On values on LG G5 phone.
symptom: Lockscreen value does not update (static after started) while notification value updates normally. Settings for both are not persistent and do not survive rebooting the phone, but can be re-enabled with settings. Settings show controls are 'On', but have to turn them off, do the 'test' and turn back on.
evidence_quote: Lockscreen value does not update (static after started) - Note: Notification value does update normally.
